theme: From recommendations to the For You page
editorNotes: Draft from the expanded master archive: Emma, SoundCloud, Musical.ly, gaming, and pop-girl crossover. Review sources and wording before approval; all new ideas remain off the live site.

daily.question: Which creator launched Chamberlain Coffee in 2019?
daily.explanation: Emma Chamberlain launched her namesake coffee brand in 2019.

daily.question: Which future pop star first uploaded “Ocean Eyes” to SoundCloud in 2015?
daily.explanation: Billie Eilish uploaded Ocean Eyes, written and produced by Finneas, to SoundCloud in 2015.

daily.question: Which lip-sync app merged into TikTok in August 2018?
daily.explanation: Musical.ly accounts and content were integrated into TikTok in August 2018.

daily.question: Which group’s fans use the name “EYEKONS”?
daily.explanation: EYEKONS is KATSEYE’s official fandom name.

daily.question: PinkPantheress and Ice Spice teamed up on which 2023 track?
daily.explanation: Boy’s a Liar Pt. 2 is the PinkPantheress collaboration featuring Ice Spice.

daily.question: Emma’s 2018 Sister Squad videos also featured James Charles and which twins?
daily.explanation: The Sister Squad featured Emma Chamberlain, James Charles, Ethan Dolan, and Grayson Dolan.

daily.question: Which YouTuber’s channel was known as “Macbarbie07”?
daily.explanation: Bethany Mota began posting under Macbarbie07, a username tied to the early beauty and lifestyle era.

daily.question: In the early YouTube gaming era, whose fans were called the “Bro Army”?
daily.explanation: Bro Army was the name associated with PewDiePie’s early fan community.

daily.question: What was Vine’s original maximum video length?
daily.explanation: Vine’s defining format was a looping video of up to six seconds.

daily.question: Which One Direction member’s debut solo album was “Flicker”?
daily.explanation: Niall Horan released his debut solo album Flicker in 2017.

tumblr.question: Sherlock’s Jim Moriarty was played by…
tumblr.explanation: Andrew Scott played Moriarty in the BBC Sherlock series.

tumblr.question: Who played Merlin in the BBC series Merlin?
tumblr.explanation: Colin Morgan played Merlin; Bradley James played Arthur.

tumblr.question: Which actor played Dean Winchester?
tumblr.explanation: Jensen Ackles played Dean in Supernatural.

tumblr.question: Which actor played Sam Winchester?
tumblr.explanation: Jared Padalecki played Sam in Supernatural.

tumblr.question: David Tennant first played which numbered Doctor?
tumblr.explanation: Tennant’s first Doctor incarnation was the Tenth.

youtube.question: Which creator launched the series Escape the Night?
youtube.explanation: Joey Graceffa created and starred in Escape the Night.

youtube.question: The Dolan Twins’ first names are…
youtube.explanation: Ethan and Grayson Dolan are the Dolan Twins.

youtube.question: Which duo’s shared channel is called KianAndJc?
youtube.explanation: Kian Lawley and JC Caylen post together as KianAndJc.

youtube.question: Our2ndLife is often abbreviated…
youtube.explanation: O2L was the shorthand for the collaborative channel Our2ndLife.

youtube.question: Lilly Singh’s earlier YouTube name was…
youtube.explanation: Lilly Singh became known under IISuperwomanII.

modern.question: Which Slushy Noobz collaborator is known as Hamzah the Fantastic?
modern.explanation: Hamzah uses the online name Hamzah the Fantastic.

modern.question: Martin’s recurring online name includes…
modern.explanation: Martin is associated with the name martin909.

modern.question: Kurtis Conner’s fan community is often called…
modern.explanation: Kurtistown is the community name associated with Kurtis Conner.

modern.question: Broski Nation is associated with…
modern.explanation: Brittany Broski’s community uses the name Broski Nation.

modern.question: Good Mythical Morning viewers are often called…
modern.explanation: Mythical Beasts is the community name used by Rhett and Link.

ask.theme: From recommendations to the For You page
clues: A place where a bedroom upload could find its first listeners.
Creators shared audio through profiles, links, and reposts.
Its waveforms made a track look like something you could trace.
“Ocean Eyes” found an early home here in 2015.
An orange cloud is part of its branding.
This music-sharing platform’s name joins sound with cloud.
ask.explanation: SoundCloud connects the era’s independent music uploads and online discovery. Billie Eilish’s Ocean Eyes was uploaded there in 2015.
